upload.supports: Supports .zip and .tar.gz archives exported from Mastodon
upload.step_1: Log in to your Mastodon instance
upload.step_2: Go to Preferences → Import and Export → Export
upload.guide_title: How to Export Your Mastodon Archive
upload.guide_step1_desc: From your Mastodon home page, click "Preferences" in the right sidebar navigation.
upload.guide_step2_desc: Navigate to "Import and export" → "Export" in the left menu. Click "Download your archive" to get your data file.
upload.sync_desc: Upload archive to Drive to access from other devices.
upload.local_desc: Upload directly from your computer without syncing.
upload.sync_sync_desc: Log in to Google and enable Google Drive. Your Mastodon archive will be stored in your own Google Drive for remote sync. This website does not store or access any of your Mastodon data.
upload.sync_local_desc: Each archive is parsed locally in your browser but will be persistently saved and won't disappear on refresh.
upload.no_archive_in_drive: No archive found in your Drive. Please upload your Mastodon archive.
upload.invalid_format: Please upload .zip or .tar.gz format Mastodon archive files
upload.empty_file: File is empty, please select a valid archive file
upload.cannot_read:
Cannot read file. Please ensure:
1. The file is not being used by another program
2. The file has not been moved or deleted
3. The browser has permission to access the file

Please close other programs that might be using the file and try again.
upload.parse_failed: Archive parsing failed, please check the file format
upload.permission_error:
File read permission error. Possible solutions:
1. Close programs using the file (e.g. decompression software, antivirus)
2. Copy the file to another location and try again
3. Check if the file is corrupted
4. Try using a different browser
upload.drive_search_failed: Could not read the archive list from Drive
upload.drive_scope_error: Google authorization is missing Drive permission. Please re-authorize.
